name: web
description: Web UIs: the verifier's browser drive (readiness probe, landmark wait, seeded storage state) through Playwright MCP, run by the pack's web-ui-verifier agent, and an executor self-check before handoff (route load, console errors, one accessibility snapshot).

verifier.when: the runtime check is a web UI drive

install_hint: Install the Playwright plugin for Claude Code (playwright@claude-plugins-official) so the web-ui-verifier agent has its browser tools.
